email_subject: Volunteering/Internship: Social Media and Content Officer
email_body:
Dear Embrace the Earth Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Social Media and Content Officer volunteer/internship position. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media integration, I am eager to contribute to your mission of protecting nature and tackling climate change.

In my current role at Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, while my personal project mirook.com showcases my ability to design engaging content and integrate social media. I am proficient in Canva and basic video editing, and I stay updated on social media trends. I am particularly drawn to your organization's focus on education and community action, and I believe my skills can help amplify your message.

I can commit to the required 2 hours daily and am open to a long-term volunteer role. I am excited about the opportunity to develop my skills in environmental communication while making a real impact.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Embrace the Earth Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Social Media and Content Officer volunteer/internship position. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, social media integration, and web design, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of protecting nature and tackling climate change through education and community action.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in creating keyword-targeted content, managing WordPress sites, and analyzing performance metrics. I am skilled in using Canva for visual content and have experience with basic video editing, which I have applied to create engaging social media posts. My personal project, mirook.com, involved designing a multi-page website with integrated social media feeds, demonstrating my ability to create cohesive digital experiences that engage audiences.

I am particularly drawn to Embrace the Earth because of your focus on environmental education and community engagement. I believe that effective communication is key to inspiring action, and I am eager to apply my skills to help grow your online community and amplify your campaigns. I am proactive, creative, and comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. I am also committed to staying updated on social media trends and best practices to ensure our content remains relevant and impactful.

I can dedicate the required 2 hours daily and am open to a long-term volunteer commitment. This position offers a valuable opportunity to develop my skills in environmental communication and digital storytelling, which aligns with my career goals. I am excited about the possibility of contributing to your team and making a positive impact.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support Embrace the Earth's mission.

Sincerely,
